pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate polygonal regions with jagged, high-contrast boundaries. Pigmentation is heterogeneous with darker central regions and slightly lighter margins.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored negative space forming a topological graph of primarily tri-radiate junctions with relatively uniform pixel width across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude bristled silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge visible against the foliage background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: The continuous mane line is interrupted at the shoulder junction by the silhouette of a perched avian organism.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, linear, light-toned mark is visible on the posterior flank, oriented diagonally and intersecting multiple dark patches.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the neck and the shoulder.
